method: Read PT/EN projection with hash-shuffled alternatives only; record all8 answers and32 alternative rationales before published-key, explanation or prior-decision reveal. Procedural separation is not human review or proof against prior model knowledge.

solutions.reasonPT: Os testes dão evidência delimitada sobre qualidade e o risco de cobrança dupla para informar stakeholders. Não decidem automaticamente a disponibilização nem provam ausência de defeitos nas viagens não testadas. Transfers num operador de transportes são transbordos, não transferências bancárias.

optionAssessmentsEN.o1: Following a documented process can support confidence, but these product test results do not establish process compliance as sufficient release evidence.
optionAssessmentsEN.o2: The observed double charge and successful tested journeys supply product-quality and concrete risk evidence for stakeholder judgment, within the tested scope.
optionAssessmentsEN.o3: A passing proportion alone ignores the significance of charging defects; testing informs rather than mechanically dictates the business release decision.
optionAssessmentsEN.o4: Revealing a charging failure is testing; repairing faulty charging logic is debugging/development, not the direct contribution of test execution described.

solutions.reasonPT: A abordagem deve adaptar disponibilidade, cobertura e conservação das evidências às obrigações e riscos do serviço de emergência. Não basta manter o método por a linguagem ser igual, só aumentar exemplos funcionais ou escolher formalidade máxima sem análise do contexto.

optionAssessmentsEN.o1: More functional examples alone do not address strict availability or the evidence-retention audit obligation; the existing targets and detail cannot be assumed adequate.
optionAssessmentsEN.o2: A common implementation language does not fix the domain risks, availability obligations, regulatory context or appropriate testware detail.
optionAssessmentsEN.o3: Tailoring availability testing, coverage and retained evidence addresses the service-specific risk and obligations together.
optionAssessmentsEN.o4: Maximum formality selected before assessing obligations substitutes a blanket rule for contextual tailoring. Formality may ultimately be appropriate, but must be justified.

solutions.reasonPT: Rever o calendário após atraso é controlo/gestão de testes; derivar casos de condições é conceção técnica de testes. A mesma pessoa pode acumular funções. A classificação depende da tarefa predominante, não do título profissional ou exclusividade.

optionAssessmentsEN.o1: Both tasks involve decisions, but that does not classify technical case derivation as test management; the nature of each task matters.
optionAssessmentsEN.o2: Being a team member rather than a designated manager does not turn schedule control into the technical testing role.
optionAssessmentsEN.o3: The task distinction is largely right, but the inference that different people must perform them is unsupported and contrary to possible role combination.
optionAssessmentsEN.o4: Schedule control is mainly management and deriving cases is mainly technical testing; a single person may perform both roles in context.

solutions.reasonPT: É necessário ouvir a regra prevista, esclarecer o significado de negócio com um exemplo e discutir evidência construtivamente. A classificação reportada não prova defeito confirmado. Mais reproduções ou relatórios não resolvem por si a divergência semântica; atribuir unilateralmente o negócio ao programador não garante resolução.

optionAssessmentsEN.o1: Listening, concrete comparison against agreed business meaning and constructive evidence discussion address the semantic disagreement without declaring either participant automatically right.
optionAssessmentsEN.o2: More data may help reproduce behaviour, but deferring discussion of the disputed business term does not resolve the interpretation problem.
optionAssessmentsEN.o3: Implementation terminology can aid communication, but delegating the business meaning solely to the developer does not establish the agreed business rule.
optionAssessmentsEN.o4: Escalation can become appropriate if discussion fails; immediate escalation based on counts of similar reports does not establish the correctness of the tester interpretation.

solutions.reasonPT: Incrementos utilizáveis frequentes com requisitos mutáveis pedem teste estático e dinâmico dentro dos incrementos, feedback rápido e regressão ao longo da evolução. Adiar toda regressão ou teste dinâmico de sistema ao fim perde feedback; planos detalhados imutáveis ignoram mudança.

optionAssessmentsEN.o1: Reviewing requirements early is useful, but deferring dynamic system testing until the final increment fails to support usable intermediate increments adequately.
optionAssessmentsEN.o2: Early planning is helpful, but designing every detail upfront and freezing it ignores the explicit possibility of requirement changes between increments.
optionAssessmentsEN.o3: Static and dynamic checks within increments, rapid feedback and evolving regression address both incremental delivery and change risk.
optionAssessmentsEN.o4: New acceptance tests alone omit effects on existing behaviour; deferring regression until final release gives late feedback on accumulating changes.

solutions.reasonPT: Automação pode reduzir repetição e acelerar feedback, mas requer preparação/manutenção e não elimina investigação manual centrada no utilizador no cenário. DevOps promove colaboração; não transfere simplesmente os testes para operações após publicação.

optionAssessmentsEN.o1: DevOps does not require every testing activity to be a repeatable automated check; exploratory user-focused investigation is not eliminated by the pipeline.
optionAssessmentsEN.o2: Faster feedback and reduced repetitive work are potential benefits, while maintaining automation and human user-focused testing remain relevant in this scenario.
optionAssessmentsEN.o3: A collaborative delivery pipeline does not mainly move testing ownership to operations after deployment; this is a siloed misunderstanding.
optionAssessmentsEN.o4: Faster execution does not justify deferring maintenance until a production regression; stale or unreliable checks undermine useful feedback.

solutions.reasonPT: Verificar os registos devolvidos é objetivo funcional; medir tempo de resposta com carga acordada é não funcional. Ambos estão no nível de sistema e podem executar a mesma função; a classificação pede objetivo principal, não nível nem inferência de caixa-branca.

optionAssessmentsEN.o1: Executing the same search does not make every objective functional; response-time behaviour under workload is a non-functional quality concern.
optionAssessmentsEN.o2: The statement fixes both at system-test level; it gives no basis for reclassifying the first as component testing.
optionAssessmentsEN.o3: Nothing about using implementation structure versus external specifications is given; white-box/black-box is not the stated objective contrast.
optionAssessmentsEN.o4: Specified records test what the function does, while response time under agreed workload tests how well it performs; functional versus non-functional is the best objective classification.

solutions.reasonPT: Após registo individual, discutir e analisar anomalias para determinar defeitos, responsáveis, ações e seguimento é comunicação e análise. Não é início, revisão individual já feita nem correção/elaboração de relatórios ainda não descrita.

optionAssessmentsEN.o1: Review initiation prepares participants, access and roles before review work; the scenario is already analysing individually logged anomalies.
optionAssessmentsEN.o2: Determining anomaly status, ownership, required actions and possible follow-up in discussion matches communication and analysis.
optionAssessmentsEN.o3: Individual anomaly identification has already occurred; the current joint status/action discussion is a different activity.
optionAssessmentsEN.o4: Fixing defects and reporting results follow decisions; agreeing actions and classifying anomalies does not itself mean the product has been corrected or the review reported.
